title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 241 N 4th Street in Grand Junction, Colorado, as the "Deputy Sheriff Derek Geer Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 241 N 4th Street in Grand Junction, Colorado, as the "Deputy Sheriff Derek Geer Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Grand Junction, Colorado post office building after Deputy Sheriff Derek Geer.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 241 N 4th Street in Grand Junction, Colorado. The building will be officially called the "Deputy Sheriff Derek Geer Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change postal services or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
